```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Paths relative to this Rmd's location (Adriana_analysis/scripts/)
project_dir <- ".."
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_functions.rda"))

paths       <- setup_project_paths(project_dir)
tables_dir  <- paths$tables_dir
figures_dir <- paths$figures_dir

```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)
library(patchwork)

# Fix dplyr::select/AnnotationDbi namespace clash
select <- dplyr::select

# Shared colour palette for dissertation figures
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_colours.rda"))
```

```{r establish-pc-directions}
# Establish biological direction of PC1/PC2 by correlating sample-level
# PC scores with mean cell volume. PC1 vs volume: Spearman r = -0.216,
# so PC1 reflects TOR/PKA signalling state rather than cell size
# (positive NES = active signalling, negative = inhibited). PC2 vs
# volume: Spearman r = +0.795, so PC2 is the primary cell size axis
# (positive NES = upregulated in large cells, negative = small cells).
pca_samples <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_samples_AC.txt"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE)

pc_vol_cor <- pca_samples %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_cell_volume)) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_PC1_vol = cor(PC1, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman"),
    cor_PC2_vol = cor(PC2, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman")
  )

cat("PC1 vs cell volume (Spearman r):", round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC1_vol, 3), "\n")
cat("PC2 vs cell volume (Spearman r):", round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC2_vol, 3), "\n")

# Direction labels used in plot annotations
direction_labels <- list(
  pc1_pos = "Positive NES = active TOR/PKA signalling state",
  pc1_neg = "Negative NES = TOR/PKA-inhibited state",
  pc2_pos = "Positive NES = upregulated in large cells",
  pc2_neg = "Negative NES = upregulated in small cells"
)
```

```{r load-data}
# PCA_genes_AC.txt: gene-level PC scores. PC4 onward is noise-level
# variance, so only PC1/PC2 are carried forward.
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r make-ranked-lists}
# GSEA operates on all genes ranked by PC score (descending), avoiding
# the hard 10% cutoff used in scripts 01/02. Genes at the positive end
# of a PC contribute to positive NES; genes at the negative end
# contribute to negative NES. Seed set before each run for reproducibility.
make_ranked_list <- function(df, pc_col) {
  df %>%
    select(gene_id, all_of(pc_col)) %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[pc_col]])) %>%
    deframe()
}

ranked_pc1 <- make_ranked_list(pca_genes, "PC1")
ranked_pc2 <- make_ranked_list(pca_genes, "PC2")

cat("PC1 ranked list:", length(ranked_pc1), "genes, range [",
    round(min(ranked_pc1), 3), ",", round(max(ranked_pc1), 3), "]\n")
cat("PC2 ranked list:", length(ranked_pc2), "genes, range [",
    round(min(ranked_pc2), 3), ",", round(max(ranked_pc2), 3), "]\n")
```

```{r run-gsea-function}
# gseGO wrapper. ont = "ALL" tests BP, MF, and CC in one run (matching
# Adriana's approach), avoiding three separate calls to combine. The
# .sign column from gseGO("ALL") is used downstream to split
# positive/negative NES terms into separate panels. nPermSimple = 1000
# for stable p-value estimates; seed set inside wrapper for reproducibility.
run_gsea_go <- function(ranked_list, label) {
  set.seed(42)
  result <- gseGO(
    geneList      = ranked_list,
    OrgDb         = org.Sc.sgd.db,
    keyType       = "ORF",
    ont           = "ALL",
    minGSSize     = 10,
    maxGSSize     = 500,
    pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    verbose       = FALSE,
    nPermSimple   = 1000
  )
  cat(label, "-", nrow(as.data.frame(result)), "enriched terms\n")
  result
}
```

```{r run-pc1}
gsea_pc1 <- run_gsea_go(ranked_pc1, "PC1")
```

```{r run-pc2}
gsea_pc2 <- run_gsea_go(ranked_pc2, "PC2")
```

```{r plot-function}
# Two-panel GSEA figure per PC: Panel A = top 20 positive-NES terms,
# Panel B = top 20 negative-NES terms. This uses the .sign split
# approach from Adriana's script, making directionality clear from
# layout rather than relying on colour alone. Panels assembled with
# patchwork, matching the figure layout convention from script 01.
plot_gsea_panel <- function(gsea_result, sign, panel_label,
                             direction_label) {
  df <- as.data.frame(gsea_result)

  df_sign <- df %>%
    filter(if (sign == "activated") NES > 0 else NES < 0) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    mutate(
      Description_short = truncate_wrap_description(Description),
      Description_short = fct_reorder(Description_short, abs(NES)),
      ONTOLOGY = factor(ONTOLOGY, levels = c("BP", "MF", "CC"))
    )

  if (nrow(df_sign) == 0) {
    cat("No", sign, "NES terms for panel", panel_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  ggplot(df_sign, aes(x = NES, y = Description_short,
                      size = setSize, color = ONTOLOGY)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = project_colours["grey"]) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "BP" = project_colours["blue"],
      "MF" = project_colours["red"],
      "CC" = project_colours["purple"]
    )) +
    labs(
      tag   = panel_label,
      x     = "Normalised Enrichment Score (NES)",
      y     = direction_label,
      size  = "Gene set size",
      color = "GO namespace"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "italic",
                                  color = "grey40"),
      plot.tag     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
    )
}

make_gsea_figure <- function(gsea_result, figure_title,
                              pos_label, neg_label) {
  p_pos <- plot_gsea_panel(gsea_result, "activated", "A", pos_label)
  p_neg <- plot_gsea_panel(gsea_result, "suppressed", "B", neg_label)

  if (is.null(p_pos) & is.null(p_neg)) return(NULL)
  if (is.null(p_pos)) return(p_neg)
  if (is.null(p_neg)) return(p_pos)

  p_pos / p_neg +
    plot_annotation(
      title = figure_title,
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                              size = 11, hjust = 0))
    )
}
```

```{r figure-pc1, fig.width=10, fig.height=18}
# Figure X: PC1 GSEA. Panel A = positive NES (active TOR/PKA
# signalling), Panel B = negative NES (TOR/PKA-inhibited).
fig_gsea_pc1 <- make_gsea_figure(
  gsea_result   = gsea_pc1,
  figure_title  = paste0(
    "GO enrichment of PC1 gene scores (GSEA)\n",
    "PC1 vs cell volume: Spearman r = ",
    round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC1_vol, 3),
    "  |  PC1 reflects TOR/PKA signalling state, not cell size"
  ),
  pos_label = direction_labels$pc1_pos,
  neg_label = direction_labels$pc1_neg
)

print(fig_gsea_pc1)
```

```{r figure-pc2, fig.width=10, fig.height=18}
# Figure X: PC2 GSEA. Panel A = positive NES (upregulated in large
# cells), Panel B = negative NES (upregulated in small cells).
fig_gsea_pc2 <- make_gsea_figure(
  gsea_result   = gsea_pc2,
  figure_title  = paste0(
    "GO enrichment of PC2 gene scores (GSEA)\n",
    "PC2 vs cell volume: Spearman r = ",
    round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC2_vol, 3),
    "  |  PC2 is the primary cell size axis"
  ),
  pos_label = direction_labels$pc2_pos,
  neg_label = direction_labels$pc2_neg
)

print(fig_gsea_pc2)
```

```{r save-outputs}
# Save results tables

          file.path(output_dir, "go_gsea_pc1.txt"))
write_tsv(as.data.frame(gsea_pc2),

# Save combined figures

  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "figure_gsea_pc1.png"),
         plot = fig_gsea_pc1, width = 10, height = 18)
}

if (!is.null(fig_gsea_pc2)) {
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "figure_gsea_pc2.png"),
         plot = fig_gsea_pc2, width = 10, height = 18)
}

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
